stem: Which sentence best completes this diagram?

options.label: A
options.text: The president authorizes a military strike against forces threatening the borders of Western Europe.

options.label: B
options.text: Congress appropriates funding for nuclear arms facilities in Western Europe.

options.label: C
options.text: The president signs a treaty requiring reparations to be paid to Western European countries.

options.label: D
options.text: Congress passes a bill to provide financial assistance to Western European countries.

visual_elements: Post–World War II Events diagram: Three boxes connected with right arrows from left to right. First box: 'World War II devastates Europe’s infrastructure and economies.' Middle box titled 'U.S. Response' contains a question mark. Last box titled 'Effects on Western Europe' lists: 'Improved political stability', 'Closer ties with the United States', 'Recovering economies'.
